ns2:course.label: Commercial & Technical Translation
ns2:course.description: Theoretical and practical aspects of translation of various genres of commercial and technical content, for example, annual reports, product specifications, marketing web sites, user manuals, online help, etc. Prerequisite: Six semesters of non-English language study or equivalent competence.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: Six semesters of non-English language study or equivalent competence.
